faq.q: How early should I make my Black Friday ads?
faq.a: Start before the offer is final so you can make versions in minutes, not weeks of prep, and finish the visuals before launch.

faq.q: Can you add a countdown timer to my video?
faq.a: No. Add the countdown in CapCut or with your ad platform tools, where you control the exact end time.

faq.q: Do I need a separate video for each platform?
faq.a: Use the size your channel needs. Each version is its own generation, with the credit cost shown before you start.

faq.q: Which Black Friday details should stay editable until the offer is final?
faq.a: Keep the price, discount, code and end date editable so you can update the wording after download without rebuilding the product scene.

faq.q: Do I need a creator or a shoot?
faq.a: No. Start from the product photo you upload and a chosen scene, so the sale set does not depend on filming anyone.

faq.q: Can I run these creatives as paid Black Friday ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloaded files carry no AIVideosUGC watermark and are yours to use in paid campaigns, subject to each platform’s ad rules.
